title: GET /briefings/current data (lld.md#briefings)
description: The deterministic since-last-review snapshot. Each section carries full concern projections, the same shape as sync. summary is always null until the inference slice adds cited summaries; the phone ignores it.

snapshotSeq.description: The review cursor this snapshot covers through; never beyond the first item left out of a capped section.

hasMore.description: True when new or changed work beyond a section cap was left out: snapshotSeq then stops before the first omitted item, and marking this briefing reviewed leaves the rest for the next one.
